listing.name: The Abyss Stares Back [1.1]
listing.summary: Gives the shrouded eye a laser pointer that instills fear in any ship it touches, causing them to back away. This may make shrouded fights easier, depending on whether or not you are running ships that could otherwise just facetank the eye. Comes in two flavors, one with a visible targeting laser (I SEE YOU), one without
listing.aiSummary: Adds a fear-inducing laser pointer to the Shrouded Eye, causing ships it touches to back away.

description: Instills fear in any ship touched by the Shrouded Eye's new laser pointer, forcing them to retreat. This can make encounters with the anomaly easier, depending on whether your fleet can otherwise withstand its attacks. Two versions are available: one with a visible targeting laser and one without.

removing.quote: NOT safe to remove mid save, but you can nullify the mod by going into data/hulls and removing the entry for shrouded_eye.ship. Then the mod will have no effect on your existing save.
